verdict.rationale: Metorial documents that you can upload your own MCP server code and have it hosted, with scaling and monitoring handled for you (docs-5, docs-23). Magic MCP then exposes a provider's tools through one hosted endpoint (docs-34). However, the uploaded code must already be an MCP server, and nothing shows converting an OpenAPI definition or plain custom code into MCP without writing protocol plumbing. Missing for 10: OpenAPI-to-MCP generation, wrapping arbitrary non-MCP code without protocol work, any detail on the custom-provider build/deploy workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.
